Helpful information

Website terms

How to use our inspiration, collection concepts and enquiry process.

✳

On this page

Design inspirationCollections and quotationsMaking an enquiryConfirming arrangementsYour venue and suppliersExternal links and questions
01

Design inspiration

Images labelled AI concept are generated visual inspiration. They illustrate possible decorative directions, not completed client work or a guarantee of a particular result. Approved event photographs uploaded by our team appear in a separate collection; details and availability for your own event are confirmed in your quotation.

02

Collections and quotations

Collection descriptions are starting points for discussion. Final decoration, materials, coordination, venue requirements, availability, prices and any additional costs need to be specified in a personalised quotation.

03

Making an enquiry

An enquiry starts a conversation. It does not confirm availability, reserve a date or create a booking. The team will discuss suitable next steps directly with you.

04

Confirming arrangements

Booking, payment, changes and cancellation arrangements are agreed directly before you proceed. This website does not accept online payments. Review the final proposal and clarify any questions before confirming.

05

Your venue and suppliers

Venue rules, access, installation timing, technical requirements and any third-party suppliers should be discussed as part of the agreed scope. Do not assume that catering, entertainment, technical production or venue hire is included.

06

External links and questions

WhatsApp and Instagram links open services operated by their respective providers. Their terms apply when you use them. If something about a proposal or this website is unclear, contact Purple Fox before making a decision.

Need a little clarity?

We’re happy to discuss questions about your enquiry.
